_rules: All visible copy lives here. Plain, short, specific. No em or en dashes anywhere. No metrics or numbers that are not needed. Banned words: leverage (verb), delve, landscape, showcase, pivotal, seamless, robust, empower (except 'Empower Sleep'), unlock, transform. Statuses must match reality: 'Live' only when the project is finished and running; 'In progress' otherwise, even if a demo is up.
name: Nate Victor

meta.title: Nate Victor
meta.description: Nate Victor. Founder and CEO of MedStrata AI. Started building and going on side quests at 13.

hero.line: Started building & going on side quests since 13 years old.

now.headline: I'm the founder and CEO of MedStrata AI.
now.text: We're building the fully autonomous back office for independent pharmacies.

sidequests.title: Things I build to learn something new.
sidequests.dek: Most of them run in your browser, so go poke around.

items.name: AI Race Engineer
items.line: Two real qualifying laps, replayed side by side. See which corners won the lap and which gave time away.

items.name: Argus
items.line: Replay a day of quakes, fires, flights and satellites on a globe. Click any sentence in the brief to see the record behind it.

items.name: Photoncar
items.line: Car data you can check. Click a hard stop or a 0 to 60 run and see the exact readings behind it.

items.name: Imperium
items.line: Simulated drones search for a raft on their own. When one wants to leave its route, it has to ask you first.

items.name: Claude Learner
items.line: Prep for the Claude Certified Architect exam in a few minutes a day. Answer questions, then explain the idea back in one sentence.

items.name: USVC for iOS
items.line: What if USVC had an iPhone app? An unofficial concept you can tap through in your browser, on sample data.

more.name: Chisel
more.line: An AI agent for CAD. Describe a part in plain English and get back files a machine shop can use.

more.name: Sherlock Holmes AI
more.line: A team of AI investigators. Point them at a company, a person or a question, and get a sourced report back.

timeline.title: The short version.
timeline.dek: From a fantasy sports app at 13 to MedStrata.

entries.title: Fantasy sports app
entries.text: At 13, I taught myself JavaScript and built a fantasy sports app for my friends and their dads. Apple rejected it.

entries.title: Online stores
entries.text: Built and ran a few. Most of them lost to competition.

entries.title: Facebook ads for real estate agents
entries.text: Figured out ads for a few agents I knew, then sold them the leads. My first real sales.

entries.title: Life insurance
entries.text: Got licensed and built a small sales team. Then the chargebacks hit.

entries.title: Skipped college
entries.text: Graduated high school and kept building instead.

entries.title: Smart Frost Film
entries.text: Resold film that turns glass frosted with a remote. The supplier never delivered.

entries.title: Insuraflow AI
entries.text: Claude got me coding again. I built an AI system for insurance agents, for the wrong audience.

entries.title: Empower Sleep
entries.text: Booked meetings for a healthcare sales team and learned how healthcare buys.

entries.title: MedStrata AI
entries.text: Started building the back office I wish every independent pharmacy had.

about.title: I'm Nate.
text: I'm 20 and live in Red Bank, New Jersey. I taught myself to code at 13 and skipped college to keep building.

contact.title: Say hi.
contact.text: Building something, curious about pharmacy, or just want to talk F1? I'm easy to reach.

footer.note: Built with Vite and TypeScript. No framework.
